gtfsIdentity.currentPassengerAccessReview: The current Tosaden airport-access map (2026-02-01) distinguishes the airport-feed Kochi-ekimae alighting position north of the boarding position. The official Kochi Prefecture completed JR Kochi station aerial, published in its 2023 urban-planning report (table current to 2023-03-31; photograph capture date unstated), depicts public station-front sidewalks/plaza and the pedestrian overpass east of the tram intersection joining the north/south sidewalk sides. Review the coarse public walking relation from the north-side alighting sidewalk to that overpass, across it, and along the south-side sidewalk to the boarding position. Do not infer a curb merge, exact traced geometry, private-property passage, accessibility, distance, or timetable. The operator map binds the two directional poles; the aerial corroborates the public passage only. Native stop identities and GTFS pickup/dropoff constraints remain distinct and unchanged.
